text_span: documented within 28 days prior to randomization
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: clinically significant pericardial effusion is a distinct screening target. The documentation timing qualifier applies to this alternative and is preserved as a separate exact source segment.

text_span: clinically significant ascites documented within 28 days prior to randomization
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: clinically significant ascites is a distinct screening target with the shared documentation timing requirement.
